name: NATO Phonetic
description: Spells the text with the NATO alphabet.
legacyScript: function animate(env,el,p){ var M={"A":"Alpha","B":"Bravo","C":"Charlie","D":"Delta","E":"Echo","F":"Foxtrot","G":"Golf","H":"Hotel","I":"India","J":"Juliett","K":"Kilo","L":"Lima","M":"Mike","N":"November","O":"Oscar","P":"Papa","Q":"Quebec","R":"Romeo","S":"Sierra","T":"Tango","U":"Uniform","V":"Victor","W":"Whiskey","X":"Xray","Y":"Yankee","Z":"Zulu"}; var t=el.text.toUpperCase(),o=[]; for(var i=0;i<t.length;i++){ var ch=t.charAt(i); if(M[ch])o.push(M[ch]); else if(ch===" ")o.push("|"); else o.push(ch); } el.text=o.join(" "); return el; }
